name: Both team flag images render the correct flags on the match detail page
description: When a visitor opens a match permalink, both team flag images render as real graphics (not broken or placeholder) and show the correct national flag for each of the two teams in the match.

planSteps.description: Read the first match id from the response
Navigate to /match/<first-id> using the captured id
Verify the match detail page shows two team flag images, each actually rendered as a real graphic (not a broken-image box or placeholder) and matching the correct national flag of the team it labels
